strategies:
name: Autoscale the frontend
description: Target-tracking on CPU, 1–4 replicas behind the load balancer — instead of sizing for the peak.
changes:
  - service: frontend
    autoscale: { min: 1, max: 4, targetCpu: 0.6, warmupS: 10, cooldownS: 120, intervalS: 15 }
name: Frontend on 1 vCPU
description: Double the frontend's CPU limit (0.5 → 1 core). It is CPU-bound, so capacity should follow.
changes:
  - service: frontend
    cpu: 1
name: Frontend and cart on Graviton
description: Arm pricing for the two busiest services; equal throughput assumed until benchmarked.
changes:
  - service: frontend
    arch: arm
  - service: cart
    arch: arm
name: Cache in front of the product catalog
description: 80% of catalog lookups served from a cache node (ElastiCache cache.r7g.large).
changes:
  - service: product-catalog
    cache: { hitRate: 0.8 }
